goals.title: Steer the Map, Bank the Perks
goals.summary: The truck is the steering wheel for the whole island. Whichever way it points when you advance decides which paddock you land in next, and every dinosaur you actually get into the trap hands you an upgrade that stays switched on for the rest of the game. Ride the outer edges for a clean run, or turn up the middle at the T-Rex and the Spinosaurus, where the captures get mean and your bonus multiplier grows.
instructions: Truck: hit it before you advance, because its facing decides which way you travel across the map. Out of the main gate that sets whether your first paddock holds the Gallimimus or the Brachiosaurus.
Left Ramp: shoot the lit white arrows to spell MAP, then take the left ramp to enter the paddock. The opening paddock lights the ramp after a single white arrow; every paddock after that wants three.
Set Trap Targets: work the flashing red rescue shots first. Bank enough of them and the set trap targets at the truck light up, and the first paddock only asks you for one of the two.

Helipad: deeper paddocks put the helicopter in the chain. Shoot the helipad, then move straight away, because the capture window runs on the helicopter's fuel and letting it empty means another helipad shot to refuel before you can try again.

Capture Shot: take the flashing green-and-yellow shot the dinosaur is sitting on to finish the capture. The perk is tied to that capture, so if the dinosaur gets clear of the paddock the perk leaves with it.

Truck: turning up the middle of the map points you at the T-Rex and the Spinosaurus. Both are among the toughest captures on the machine, and each one raises your bonus multiplier, which also drives Super Spinner. Steering around them keeps you on the easier outer paddocks.
Perks worth the risk: capturing the T-Rex adds eight seconds to every timer in the game, and capturing the Raptor doubles your jackpots in Raptor Multiball.
goals.reward: A game-long perk for every dinosaur you capture, plus bonus multiplier growth from the centre predators

drills.title: Soft Plunge to the C
drills.text: Soft-plunge, let the ball settle to a flipper, then take the Control Room target on the fly. On Premium and LE a miss usually deflects harmlessly toward the raptor pen, which makes this the cheapest opening shot on the machine to practise.

drills.title: Tight Orbit Reps
drills.text: Take the right orbit from the left flipper only, from a settled cradle. It is the tightest shot on the game and a brick feeds a drain, so the point of the drill is finding the exact aim rather than getting the ball round any way you can.

drills.title: Raptor Pen Backhand
drills.text: Backhand the pen standups from the left flipper and keep chipping them all game so the center stays lit. Dead-end lane shots drop the fence, so learn the pen as a place you visit constantly rather than one you rush at when the tri-ball is close.

drills.title: Helix Feed Control
drills.text: Shoot the right ramp and be set for the helix to hand the ball to the upper flipper at speed. Settle it first, then pick a shot — the Tower ramp or the Upper Loop — because the fast feed is where this ramp turns into a drain.

drills.title: Six Shots, No Clock
drills.text: Run the spinner, the Upper Loop, the Tower ramp, the Helipad, the left ramp and the right ramp in one chain. There is no combo timer here, so trap between links and set each shot up properly — this is a control exercise dressed up as a combo.

drills.title: Stack Both Loaders
drills.text: Pre-shoot the Helipad and the Tower ramp before you go back to the left ramp to collect. Both loaders stack, and collecting without them is throwing most of the award away — the drill is the patience to load first.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: Stern's lockdown bar button, and on this one it is mostly a chooser plus a panic tool. It cycles your Smart Missile award, picks which Control Room mode you play, and — once it glows green off side ramp awards — fires a Super Tranquilizer that freezes the dinosaur mid-paddock.

uses.when: Ball held at the lit left inlane
uses.what: Cycles Smart Missile awards for about three seconds; whatever shows when time expires is what the pops target pays.
Park the Smart Missile on Clear Paddock, then hit the target between the bumpers to wipe it outright.
Super Tranquilizer stuns the dino so it stops closing on your rescue shots — one stun per qualify.
A single Super Tranquilizer stuns both raptors at the same time.

uses.when: Control Room lit at the left target
uses.what: Works with the flippers to pick which of the three modes you start.

howItPlays.objective: Jurassic Park drops you onto Isla Nublar to rescue dinosaurs, feed the T-Rex, and breach the raptor pen while the island tears itself apart. Trap dinos for game-long perks, clear three mini-wizards and Escape Nublar, and reach the six-ball finale, When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth.
loop: Steer the Truck to aim your next paddock, spell MAP on the white-arrow shots, then take the Left Ramp to enter and rescue the dinosaur inside.
Every dino you trap hands you a perk that stays switched on all game, and the center predators each add a rung to your end-of-ball Bonus multiplier.
Spell C-H-A-O-S and T-REX, chip the raptor pen to zero fence integrity, and feed the Truck to arm the game's four multiballs off the Left Ramp and the pen.
Play the three Control Room modes, the four T-Rex events, and four paddocks to light the three mini-wizards, which qualify Escape Nublar at the Left Ramp.
Beat Escape Nublar to open When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth, a six-ball frenzy that ends the game when its timer dies.

lights.name: CHAOS Letters
lights.lit: Each CHAOS letter lights as you make its shot -- C at the Control Room target, H and A on the two ramps, O around the tight Right Orbit, S at the Helipad -- and a banked letter stays lit, so you only ever chase what is still dark.
lights.flashing: The Amber target in the pop nest flashes once CHAOS is fully spelled and the multiball is ready to start.
lights.then: Finish the word, then hit the flashing Amber target to start Chaos Multiball; each Chaos multiball after the first makes you spell CHAOS twice over, and banging the Truck flips which half of the playfield the jackpots sit on.

lights.name: T-REX Hurry-Up
lights.lit: Bashing the Truck's Newton ball spells T-REX one letter at a time -- the head roars on each -- and the letters hold until the word is done.
lights.flashing: A hurry-up flashes at the Left Ramp once T-REX is spelled, its value climbing every time you shoot a lit orange arrow.
lights.then: Build the value on the lit orange arrows, then bring it back to the Left Ramp to kick off Feed T-Rex Multiball; those build shots are unprotected, with no ball save until the multiball itself begins, so trap and aim rather than flail.

lights.name: Raptor Pen & Fence Integrity
lights.lit: The pen's center insert lights as you chip its standups, and the Fence Integrity meter -- starting halfway down -- drops with each dead-end lane shot; the progress holds, so keep the pen lit all game rather than rushing it when the tri-ball is close.
lights.flashing: The pen's dead-end lane flashes to start once Fence Integrity reaches zero.
lights.then: Shoot the dead-end lane at zero integrity to start Raptor Tri-Ball, the highest-ceiling multiball on the machine; work the ramp jackpots up to the Super CHAOS phase and cash the Upper Loop super at triple the chaos jackpot times balls in play.

lights.name: Smart Missile & Super Spinner Lanes
lights.lit: The left return lane lights for a Smart Missile, the right for the Super Spinner, and the left outlane for the Escape ball save once you have hit the Escape target.

control.effect: with the ball staged at the lit left return lane, a tap cycles the Smart Missile award for about three seconds and whatever shows when time runs out is what you collect -- park it on Clear Paddock and the target between the bumpers wipes a stubborn dino outright
control.when: ball held at the lit left return lane

lights.then: Roll the lit left lane to cash your chosen Smart Missile, take the right lane's Super Spinner for a burst of spin value, and keep the Escape outlane armed so a left-side drain quietly hands the ball back.

lights.name: Control Room Modes
lights.lit: The Control Room target stays lit whenever a mode is ready to start, relit across the game by Tower Ramp shots -- the fifteen-shot Tower award turns it back on.

control.effect: with Control Room lit, the flippers scroll the three modes and the action button locks in which one you start, so you can pick Restore Power or the combo-scoring System Boot to match your ball
control.when: Control Room lit, no mode running

lights.then: Backhand the lit target from the right flipper to start your pick; play all three Control Room modes across the game and one more Control Room shot starts the Secure Control Room mini-wizard, one of the three legs to Escape Nublar.

lights.name: Paddock Rescues & Perks
lights.lit: White arrows light the MAP shots, the paddock's rescue shots flash red once you are inside, and the dinosaur sits on a green-and-yellow capture shot until you trap it, with the perk it carries bound to that capture -- let the dino break clear of the paddock and the perk goes with it.
lights.flashing: The Set-Trap targets by the Truck flash when the rescue shots are banked and the capture is ready.

control.effect: once the button glows green off the side-ramp awards, a press looses a Super Tranquilizer that pins the dinosaur where it stands and halts its advance on the rescue shots -- one stun per qualify, and a single press drops both raptors together
control.when: during a paddock, button lit green

lights.then: The Truck's facing sets which paddock comes next, so aim it, spell MAP, enter at the Left Ramp, and close the capture at the Set-Trap targets; every dino trapped is a game-long perk, the center predators each raise your Bonus multiplier, and four paddocks light Visitor's Center, the first mini-wizard.

lights.name: Nedry 2X Playfield
lights.lit: Collecting a Supply Drop off the Set-Trap standups lights the Nedry 2X target, and the lit target holds until you shoot it or the ball drains.
lights.then: Hit the Nedry target with a late left-flipper shot to double all scoring for forty-five seconds, then dump it inside a jackpot-heavy multiball or a fat T-Rex Rampage collect -- it does not carry between balls, so spend it before you lose the ball.

lights.name: Mini-Wizard & Escape Progress
lights.lit: Three inserts track the mini-wizard legs -- Visitor's Center from four paddocks, Museum Mayhem from the four T-Rex events, Secure Control Room from the three Control Room modes -- and each stays lit once its leg is played.
lights.flashing: The Left Ramp flashes for Escape Nublar once all three legs are done.
lights.then: You only have to PLAY the three mini-wizards, not beat them, to light Escape Nublar at the Left Ramp; survive that single-ball dash to the gate -- a tilt ends the game outright -- and the Left Ramp opens the six-ball finale, When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth.

scoring.text: Take the tournament-favorite 'C' secret skill shot on a soft plunge -- it banks points and spots a CHAOS letter under ball save. Then steer the Truck, spell MAP, and start your first paddock at the Left Ramp; every rescue you bank raises the end-of-ball Bonus multiplier, and that carries across all your balls.

Arm the multiballs -- spell CHAOS, spell T-REX at the Truck, and drop the raptor fence to zero -- and stack Feed T-Rex Multiball over a running paddock with 2X scoring armed. T-Rex Rampage, loaded to six times at the Helipad and Tower ramps before you collect at the Left Ramp, is the repeatable money maker.

Play all three mini-wizards to light Escape Nublar at the Left Ramp, a single-ball run to the gate where one tilt ends everything. Beat it and the Left Ramp opens When Dinosaurs Ruled the Earth -- a six-ball, sixty-second frenzy with unlimited ball save that ends the game when the timer expires.
